notes.title: Tame It Too! DLC Breeding Prototype Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've updated the DLC prototype of Tame It Too! with the long-awaited breeding mechanics. We're glad to finally show you what we've got!

It's very easy to start breeding in this prototype.
Since the breeding features are not yet story related, all you need to do is clean up the camp, build a tent and a workbench, then a purple icon will appear at the edge of the camp that will allow you to start the breeding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/9e0ffde98ef0c8648792e03c9d279cd4ee687133.jpg[/img]
Please note that due to a change in the save system to support multiple saves and future game growth, old saves are not compatible with this prototype!

[h2]What awaits you in this update[/h2]

First of all, there are two new monster girls, Bunny and Lily. You'll meet and tame them as story characters in the full game, but for now, they're both ready to do a variety of naughty things with you, so you can start right away with the hottest part! 

[h3]Breeding System[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/557b27676ace19638a78fe4302e1dbd6823e2437.jpg[/img]
You can start to breed new monster beauties as soon as you launch the breeding prototype. The process of breeding new generations of girls will definitely surprise you!

At first everything is clear and quite simple, because it all starts with sex, of course! After successful impregnation, you'll be able to watch the girl's belly grow and other body changes, such as breast enlargement. You can also have sex with your pregnant beauties!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/f272a128ea63487285a645d2d4e0e9314748aead.jpg[/img]
Things become more interesting from here on out! There's nothing complicated about breeding, but the process is quite unique, so it may raise some questions.

[b]Briefly, your steps to breed a new girl are as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] Have sex. Once is enough, but you can try out all the available poses as many times as you like, just remember to keep your energy up!
[*] Click on the girl when she is lying on the bed with the red exclamation mark above her;
[*] Pick up what she gave birth to and bring it to the nest;
[*] Assign one of the girls to nurse by taking her to the nest;
[*] Wait for a new girl to appear and build a bed for her.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/421c54bf19acd101ca246417501d92dc88d5d482.jpg[/img]
All new girls appear as adults, and you can continue breeding with them right away to get even more colorful wild beauties!

[h3]Variety[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/4a86b9fb4e8f4a1214dd32a31ee311b0c8d42530.jpg[/img]
You'll be able to breed girls of many different colors and body shapes, so there's plenty of freedom for imagination and experimentation!
It will not yet be possible to breed girls of different heights, faces and several other small traits in the breeding prototype, but all this is planned for future patrons' releases! 

[h3]Construction[/h3]
There are several new items available for you to build in this prototype, the most important of which is a bed. Each girl will need her own bed for sleeping and giving birth, and a new girl cannot be born if there is no room for her in your camp. In the full game, Lee won't have to sleep in a tent while girls sleep on beds, it will be different and you'll have the opportunity to build a house for Lee.

Hurry up and try it out for yourself! Feel free to share what kind of girls you breed in our [url=https://discord.gg/EGZXXaY]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Manka_Games]Twitter[/url]! 
We'll be very grateful for your comments, so don't hesitate to tell us what you think!

This is the last of our prototypes for this game, the full-fledged Tame It Too! is ahead and we're already actively working on it! We plan to do regular releases for our patrons on Patreon, while the game is in development, and then make a big release on Steam, when the game will be finished. 
So stay tuned not to miss anything!

notes.title: Tame It Too! Second Prototype Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e6f69045ede8c4f1af01f89853ee7d762ec93d1c.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We are happy to present you the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]second prototype of Tame It Too[/url]!

We completely redesigned the game from the first prototype, rebuilding everything on a new engine, with new graphics and new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c461d6d7184610ec6738d027e2800c1647da05da.jpg[/img]
There's a pretty big island waiting for you to explore freely. In addition to the familiar local sights, we have added several new points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/56a4437b31a4fec0cbd95cea8bf1e17f3008264a.jpg[/img]
The island is full of life, there are different animals living in all corners of the island, you can hunt them or just have fun running after them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/575e7e065c648fe0a6f6b8e1676c189df57971e5.png[/img]
You'll also have the opportunity to gather resources, build your camp, cook food, everything that implies survival game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/fe6b9fb3a820e4405366180d1b13629c419afcd4.jpg[/img]
And of course you can communicate with your girls, Cat and Octa, treat them with yummy food, and watch hot scenes with each of them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/bb64b7b4fe809c392d5191d73cd39f7b433599b9.jpg[/img]
You'll be accompanied throughout the island by Fairy, who Lee has brought back from the Island of Fairies and has no intention of letting go yet. Fairy has her own opinion about everything that's going on, and she won't stop nagging and swearing at Lee the whole way. So she'll be a fun companion to set the mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/6a3920a33f6f970a26e02df264c120918d4bcfba.jpg[/img]
We should also note that since this is the prototype of the possible game, it doesn't have all the features yet and can't be considered a full-fledged continuation of the story. With this prototype, we want to show you what the future game could look like with your support.

Thank you all for your interest in our games and for your kind words of support. Thanks to you, we continue to make progress!

notes.title: 1.2.1 bugfix release and Tame It! Side Stories-2
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

Today we have a small update for Tame It! Christmas Story, fixing a strange and rare bug. Thanks to our players for reporting it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/0dbdd69ae2379ad5f3ba823c133b4caddd4ba4c8.png[/img]

Also, we decided to publish here the second comic based on the Tame It! world.
So, what's coming up in this issue?

The journey of Lee and the girls continues. Lee is not the most experienced navigator, you see, it is difficult for him to navigate and lead the raft in the right direction (and where is that 'right direction' anyways?!). So more and more islands of the archipelago come across on their way and a new adventure awaits Lee on each of them. This time the island seems harmless, but it is only at first sight! In the depths lurks something, and what exactly — you have to find out!

[b]After the game update, the comic will be available in the game folder by address:  [/b]Comics/TameIt_Comic_2.pdf

Have fun and stay tuned!

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix rare softlock in Christmas addon
[/list]

notes.title: Tame It! Christmas Story Release!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We came to you with a Christmas present today! Here is the new Tame It! addon — Christmas Story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/a04a08d6c94a924021381d2767d8b83bdb7b9c83.png[/img]
You will be immersed in the atmosphere of exciting holiday preparations, decorate a big beautiful Christmas tree in a cozy living room with a fireplace and meet your beautiful girlfriend with presents... but it's not that simple! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c6b9e3294626d63281ba19419057df3cb9c1d1a1.png[/img]
There is a mystery, cool plot twists and even a little bit of mystique waiting for you! You won't be able to predict what will happen next! This is one of Lee's most unusual adventures, so get ready to be amazed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/697728aa677e88126727be02f53d3677df3af725.png[/img]
In addition to the unusual setting, we've added new quest mechanics and a new inventory interaction. You'll be able to take an item from inventory in your hand and use it on an active area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/377fe760e51994f26b4e527e313dcc7fa8c1b48c.png[/img]
For dessert, we've prepared three amazingly hot animated scenes with a wide variety of possible actions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/2cf85f44560d81076356e521592c67d757e4288d.png[/img]
And of course we’re taking part in the Steam Winter Sale, which starts December 21st! [b]Tame It! is 50% off[/b] this time! 

Thank you for your support, dear friends! Your love for Tame It! and its characters inspired us to create this addon. We really appreciate you being with us as you help us move forward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/c9125d42b081992d022f42850b1f63d012b9b254.png[/img]
We won't keep you any longer, because Tonya is already waiting for you!

We wish you a Merry Christmas and a wonderful holiday season!

notes.title: Tame It Too! Prototype update (0.3.0)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/fdaf2078e079b928610ed0ed898c787120f655fd.png[/img]

Hi guys!

We recently celebrated a big anniversary — one year since the release of Tame It! on Steam! 
We've prepared an updated version of the Tame It Too! prototype to celebrate it with! 
 
Meet the very sharp-tongued and funny fairy who'll be accompanying Lee around the island and has her own opinion on everything! And at the end you’ll get a rather special hot scene with her! 

Tame It! is a very special game for us, and not just because it was Manka Games' first game! We have come to love the world of Tame It! and its characters, and thanks to the fact that our players also loved them and supported us from the very beginning, we decided to try making a sequel — Tame It Too! And the success of Tame It! inspired us to make other games that we’ve been working over the past year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/402660ca35ae5fdc3b5608fdbb458cad66bc7203.png[/img]

Thank you, dear friends, for being with us, for all your sweet comments, for helping us fix bugs and for all your kind words and wishes! In turn, we’ll keep bringing you joy with our games and also we hope that you will like our new game projects as much as Tame It! 💗

Have a great time and stay tuned, everyone!

notes.title: Tame It Too! Prototype update (0.2.0)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/3401d9782c795fce9f249a339b61b48c79b2d8eb.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

We've been working on improving our prototype since the first release, and the updated version is ready!

Thank you for sending us information about bugs and suggesting improvements! We noted all the bugs you reported about and have been working on fixing them. We haven't fixed them all yet, but we're on our way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/f157e6bb2baabc3059efded3376e6753de5cc89f.png[/img]

A lot of fixes have been made to the prototype and a lot has been improved. We also added idle animations for Cat and Octa, so they no longer stay in static poses. And maybe the best part for you: we added a new hot scene and it's very cool and exciting!

Hurry up and download the update to see all the changes for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/0b1e6c8c832cee759d68e7af564d37c58156d851.png[/img]

We will continue to work on the prototype. For the next update we have set a goal to add the fairy that Lee stole on Fairy Island to the game. We are currently in the middle of creating the appearance of the fairy, and all the phrases and dialogues with her are already written out! And we also want to make controls for hot scenes, so you could, for example, rotate the camera and choose the most attractive view. On top of that we will of course continue to fix bugs, improve the visual and gameplay of the prototype.

Thank you for your support, friends! As always, we will be happy to see your impressions, feedback and suggestions in the comments!


[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Migrate Unreal Engine from 5.0 to 5.1
[*] Update Fish and Dragon skeletons
[*] Improve UI
[*] Add transparent save/load system
[*] Add a scene with Cat
[*] Rework a scene with Octa
[*] Add animated idle poses for Cat and Octa

[*] Add confirmation window to terminal actions

notes.title: Tame It! DLC Release
notes.notes:
We finally made it! We are happy to bring you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219340/Tame_It_Sequel_Prototype/]the prototype of Tame It Too![/url] — our first step to a really big game! 

After the release of the first addon, we were at a crossroads. On the one hand we planned to make another addon before the end of the year, we had nice ideas for it, another little adventure on a new island with a new monster-girl. But on the other hand we couldn't stop thinking about a sequel, and we realized we had an opportunity to show you what a sequel could look like at least in prototype form. That's why in the end we decided it would be more interesting both for us and for you, dear players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/f49209fbaf8bde01a41b3d25b2a6d330e796ba09.jpg[/img]

We have been working on the prototype of Tame It Too! for over six months, and now we can finally show you what we made!
The previous engine we used for Tame It! was specifically created for visual novels and it really limited us in what we wanted to make. That's why we switched to Unreal Engine 5 for our prototype development and future game, which could bring all our ideas to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/e2a9a58cc7d87a07866834f1dc76abd61fb6e4cd.jpg[/img]

Here in the prototype you'll see just a small piece of the future world of Tame It Too! Although the available area is the equal in size to the island from the first game, and probably exceeds it, the real size of the territory, where the events of the future game will unfold, plan to be at least five times larger. But even in the territory that is available to you now, there are a lot of interesting things. We tried to include different biomes and different fauna, including the crabs you know so well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/6da268b8b875ab934684eb6693b84974372268c4.jpg[/img]

As for the character models, we use the models from the first game for now. And even Octa, who, as many of you expected, should be pregnant by now, doesn't show it yet. In the future we plan to completely rework the previous characters’ models, as well as rework and refine some of the environment models.

As a reminder, the prototype doesn't have the survival functionality you're used to and a proper plot yet. We focused on laying the base for the future game, to show you what it will look like, to let you experience more freedom in the world of Tame It! and the possibilities the new engine gave us. There may be some flaws and bugs in the game and some things, such as the bonus scene, we plan to redo in the future. 
However, Tame It Too! is a direct continuation of the first part and we meet the characters in about the same place where we parted with them. Therefore, we can consider this prototype as a story prologue to the main game. 

If you like Tame It! and you liked Tame It Too! prototype we would love to have you as part of our community and hope to create a complete game with lots of cool features together! 

Many thanks to everyone who keeps supporting us! We are very grateful to you!

notes.title: Tame It! Steam Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41010224/481b8ee0b80e1a640ba6bddb8d1ce60e099748ed.jpg[/img]

It finally happened! After almost two years of hard work Tame It! released on Steam! We’re excited to reveal the final version of our first game to you at last. It’s a unique survival adventure game, where you face a lot of interesting tasks on a small island, including communication with very unusual inhabitants of this place. Overcome the language barrier and tame wild beauties, find the traces of your missing companion and solve the mystery of the island, and of course survive — all this awaits you in Tame It!   

The game is accessible to players from all over the world, because all the dialogues and interfaces are provided using emoji! In addition, there is a full text version in English and German, as well as the option to select the difficulty level. Who knows, maybe you're an experienced Robinsons and prefer hardcore gaming?

Play it, add it to your wishlist and try the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1706850/Tame_It/

And we've got a great soundtrack too! Take the atmosphere of a tropical island adventure with you wherever you go!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711860/Tame_It_Soundtrack/

It wouldn't have been possible without the support of our dear patrons and the community, and we are really grateful to all of you! This weekend we’ll talk about our ideas and your suggestions for the sequel. And we hope to announce our next game soon enough! So stay tuned!
